name: facebookresearch_metaseq/third_party/stable-diffusion/ldm/models/diffusion/dpm_solver/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_metaseq/third_party/sta.create_noise_schedule_vp: create a NoiseScheduleVP for discrete-time diffusion models using betas or alphas_cumprod tensors

facebookresearch_metaseq/third_party/sta.register_buffer_alphas: register the model alphas_cumprod as a CUDA tensor buffer on the sampler
facebookresearch_metaseq/third_party/sta.review_dpmsolversampler_sample: review the DPMSolverSampler sample method for multistep DPM-Solver image generation

lower_order_final.description: A `bool`. Whether to use lower order solvers at the final steps.

denoise_to_zero.description: A `bool`. Whether to denoise to time 0 at the final step.
